name: manox-vscode
description: manox agent workbench inside VS Code — the headless manox runtime embedded in-process through the manox-napi binding, speaking protocol v2 (journal streams + projections + host events).

chatParticipants.name: manox
chatParticipants.description: manox agent — ask anything, it runs on the native manox runtime

manox.sdkRoot.markdownDescription: Directory containing the staged `manox_napi.node` native binding (built by `script/build-napi` in the dspo/manox repository). Resolution order: this setting, then the `VSCODE_AGENT_HOST_MANOX_SDK_ROOT` environment variable, then `<extension>/native/`.

manox.stateRoot.markdownDescription: Value for `MANOX_HOME` — the manox persistent-state root (threads database, session journals, provider config snapshot) used by the embedded runtime. Defaults to the desktop app's `~/.manox` so both surfaces share threads, models and provider config (concurrent instances are safe); set a separate directory to isolate the extension's state.

enumDescriptions: Tools may read but not modify files
Writes confined to the workspace and the manox state root
No confinement; every tool call runs unrestricted
manox.approvalMode.markdownDescription: Tool-authorization policy seeded into new manox sessions, mirroring the native `PermissionMode`.

scripts.compile: npm run typecheck && node esbuild.config.mjs && npm run build --prefix webview-ui
scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test --prefix webview-ui
